g.text: Compiler latency across images and transformations
Two checked inputs · three fresh processes per image and input · exact output checks
Right: median of 3 later requests per process, then median across processes; warmed windows, not steady state.
Separate runs in the two panels. Bars: medians. Whiskers: observed process min–max, not confidence intervals.
